periods.label: Week of August 24, 2026
periods.summaryTitle: Combat Text Performance & AI Dev Improvements

features: AI dev system: added a maintenance mode fallback for when no tasks are available
Switched local AI model backend from Ollama to llama.cpp for faster generation
bugfixes: Fixed mobile header menu UI issues
Fixed Extract action tooltip in inventory so the extracted spell is visible when hovering
performance: Combat floating text now uses cached canvases and opacity-based fading for smoother rendering
ux: Devlog request panel renamed to 'Community Change Request' with a new Graphics & Sounds category for asset and effect requests

commits.title: fix(ux): mobile UI fixes for header menu
feat: uses llamacpp instead of ollama
feat(AI-dev): add maintenance mode fallback to when there's no available tasks
fix(inventory): show the extracted spell when hovering the Extract action
commits.description:
- resolve the context menu portal when opening instead of when the card is built, so the menu stays inside the HUD root and the viewport tooltip listeners can see it
- raise the viewport tooltip overlay above the context menu z-index for both the spell and fallback tooltips
- add a regression test keeping the Extract tooltip reachable from the open menu

commits.title: perf(combat-text): allocate floating text canvases once and fade via opacity
commits.description:
- cached canvas + CanvasTexture per combat text, redrawn only when value, kind, or critical state changes
- per-frame fade now updates sprite material opacity instead of re-uploading the texture
- moved formatCombatAmount to CombatText and added combatTextRenderSignature with unit tests
- extended the runtime performance contract spec accordingly

commits.title: ux(devlog): rename request panel and add Graphics & Sounds category
commits.description:
- renamed 'Request a feature or report a bug' heading to 'Community Change Request'
- added Graphics & Sounds request type for assets, effects, particles, and engine details
- extended kind validation, badge label, and specs
